detailed_descriptions.en: Spiritstead is an easy-going and satisfying city builder. Arrive in a quiet, enchanted land where humans and magical spirits work together. Take charge and put your villagers to work as you create their homes, support their lives, and make your village beautiful along the way. Overseeing the lives of so many can be hard work, but here you have a magical place full of spirits ready to help. Discover them through interactions with the world as you meet quirky, charming creatures who make each day in your village easier to manage. Collect them all to live alongside your people and create spirit buildings to support them. Support your townsfolk by assigning them jobs, meeting all their needs, and helping them enjoy life with happiness-boosting buildings like cafes, markets, and bonfires. Unlock new buildings, decorations, and upgrades as you progress through the game to help you look after your residents. Enjoy creating the town of your dreams in a stunning bespoke visual style inspired by Miyazaki films and your favorite cartoons, handcrafted by our talented artist. Beneath its comfortable atmosphere lie hidden secrets waiting to be discovered as you expand into new territories with the help of wandering spirits and work to restore the Grand Spirit Sanctuary, bringing balance between spirits and humans. RELAXING AND SATISFYING Create freely in creative mode without any pressures and just enjoy building. Here for a satisfying challenge? Manage your villagers needs and wants as you make something as aesthetically pleasing as it is practical in adventure mode. A GENTLER EXPERIENCE Enjoy an easy to learn, addictive city builder experience. Spiritstead is a simple yet satisfying city builder with fun clicker elements and takes around 4-7 hours to play through end to end in survival mode. Spiritstead is endlessly replayable, but the game world remains the same each time.

Enjoy creating the town of your dreams in a stunning bespoke visual style inspired by Miyazaki films and your favorite cartoons, handcrafted by our talented artist. Beneath its comfortable atmosphere lie hidden secrets waiting to be discovered as you expand into new territories with the help of wandering spirits and work to restore the Grand Spirit Sanctuary, bringing balance between spirits and humans.
